SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT
    start,
    end,
    ROUND(
      POW(ABS(case_ref_count - (ref_count / allele_count) * case_count) - num, num) / ((ref_count / allele_count) * case_count) +
      POW(ABS(control_ref_count - (ref_count / allele_count) * control_count) - num, num) / ((ref_count / allele_count) * control_count) +
      POW(ABS(case_alt_count - (alt_count / allele_count) * case_count) - num, num) / ((alt_count / allele_count) * case_count) +
      POW(ABS(control_alt_count - (alt_count / allele_count) * control_count) - num, num) / ((alt_count / allele_count) * control_count),
      num
    ) AS chi_squared_score
  FROM (
    SELECT
      reference_name,
      start,
      end,
      reference_bases,
      alternate_bases,
      vt,
      SUM(ref_count + alt_count) AS allele_count,
      SUM(ref_count) AS ref_count,
      SUM(alt_count) AS alt_count,
      SUM(IF(is_case, CAST(ref_count + alt_count AS INTEGER), num)) AS case_count,
      SUM(IF(NOT is_case, CAST(ref_count + alt_count AS INTEGER), num)) AS control_count,
      SUM(IF(is_case, ref_count, num)) AS case_ref_count,
      SUM(IF(is_case, alt_count, num)) AS case_alt_count,
      SUM(IF(NOT is_case, ref_count, num)) AS control_ref_count,
      SUM(IF(NOT is_case, alt_count, num)) AS control_alt_count
    FROM (
      SELECT
        v.reference_name,
        v.start,
        v.end,
        v.reference_bases,
        v.alternate_bases,
        v.vt,
        (string = p.super_population) AS is_case,
        IF(call.genotype[SAFE_OFFSET(num)] = num, num, num) AS ref_count,
        IF(call.genotype[SAFE_OFFSET(num)] = num, num, num) AS alt_count
      FROM
        variants AS v,
        json_each(v.call) AS _je0
      JOIN
        sample_info AS p
      ON
        json_extract(_je0.value, string) = p.sample
      WHERE
        v.reference_name = string
    )
    GROUP BY
      reference_name,
      start,
      end,
      reference_bases,
      alternate_bases,
      vt
  )
  WHERE
    (ref_count / allele_count) * case_count >= num
    AND (ref_count / allele_count) * control_count >= num
    AND (alt_count / allele_count) * case_count >= num
    AND (alt_count / allele_count) * control_count >= num
)
WHERE
  chi_squared_score >= num
ORDER BY
  chi_squared_score DESC
